releases.notes:
### Added
- Resonance Compass, a craftable compass that points toward nearby Amethyst Geodes in the Overworld
- Crafting recipe using a Compass, Resonant Alloy, and Amethyst Shards

### Notes
The compass searches loaded chunks within 160 blocks. It cannot point to geodes in unexplored or unloaded areas.
Probably in the future versions I will add coordinates and blocks just as in Explorer's/Nature compass mods.

releases.notes:
### Changed

- rebalanced the Blackened tier to fit better alongside Netherite
- Blackened tools now trade some durability and enchantability for faster mining, Searing, fire resistance, and easier repairs
- updated Blackened tool combat stats to be closer to Netherite
- Blackened tools are now repaired with Resonant Alloy
- reworked Blackened component recipes to use Resonant Alloy
- Blackened Handle recipe no longer consumes a Relic Forging Template and now crafts two handles

### Added

- Amethyst Fragment
- Amethyst Blocks can now be smelted into Amethyst Fragments
- 4 Amethyst Fragments can be crafted into 1 Amethyst Shard

### Blackened Tier

- Durability: 1800
- Mining Speed: 9.5
- Enchantability: 12
- Blackened Sword: 8 Attack Damage / 1.6 Attack Speed
- Searing behavior remains unchanged

### Notes

This beta mainly focuses on progression and balance.

Blackened is now intended to sit alongside Netherite instead of simply replacing it. Resonant Alloy also has a clearer role in the progression, since it is now used as the base for Blackened components and repairs.

The new Amethyst Fragment recipe gives regular Amethyst Blocks another use while keeping normal crystal farming as the better source of Amethyst Shards.

The next step is expanding Relicforged with more utility and progression content beyond just tool tiers.

releases.notes:
## 1.0.0-beta.3

### Added

- Resonant Alloy
- Resonant Pickaxe
- Resonant Axe
- Resonant Shovel
- Resonant Hoe
- Resonant Sword
- vanilla-style crafting recipes for the full Resonant tool set

### Changed

- reorganized tier-specific item assets into Resonant, Blackened, and Voidbound resource folders

### Resonant Tier

- 610 durability
- 7.0 mining speed
- Iron mining level
- 16 enchantability
- Iron-equivalent tool damage
- Resonant Sword deals +1 damage compared with Iron Sword

### Notes

The Resonant tier is meant to fill the gap between Iron and Diamond without replacing normal Minecraft progression.

It uses common vanilla materials and gives players a more durable mid-game tool set before reaching Diamond gear.

For now, Resonant is intentionally simple and does not have any special abilities.

The next beta will focus on rebalancing the Blackened tier so it fits better alongside Netherite and the new Resonant progression.

releases.notes:
First public beta of Relicforged.

### Added

- Relic Forge workstation
- Relic Forging Template
- Blackened Handle and tool components
- Blackened Pickaxe
- Blackened Axe
- Blackened Shovel
- Blackened Hoe
- Blackened Sword

### Blackened Searing

All Blackened tools have a toggleable Searing state.

- Pickaxe, Axe and Shovel automatically smelt compatible drops
- Fortune is applied before smelting
- Silk Touch bypasses Searing
- Sword ignites targets while Searing is enabled
- Hoe currently has no additional Searing effect
- Blackened tools are fireproof and survive fire and lava

Searing can be toggled with `Shift + Right Click`.

### Forging

Diamond tools can be reforged into Blackened tools through the Relic Forge using their matching Blackened components.

Forging recipes are data-driven and use the custom `relicforged:relic_forging` recipe type.

### Notes

This is an early beta.

The Relic Forge GUI is functional but its final visual design is still work in progress. Balance, recipes and Searing behavior may change in later beta releases.

### Platform

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge
- Java 17
